name: Tianhai Auto Electronics Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Tianhai Auto Electronics Group Co., Ltd. engages in manufacturing automotive electronic parts worldwide. The company offers automotive connectors, high and low voltage wiring harnesses, and automotive electronics. It also designs and manufactures electronic transmission systems, connection systems, intelligent control systems, and low -carbon intellectual solutions. Tianhai Auto Electronics Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1969 and is based in Hebi, China.
